items.claim: Eric McConico can use his counter striking and do just enough to win a split decision.
items.quote: I think he can use a lot of the counter striking and kind of do just enough to get this one done on the scorecards and probably win a split decision.

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes is four and one in his last five fights.
items.quote: Kaue Fernandes is four and one in his last five fights, an impressive 11 and two on the career.

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes has very good movement and darts in and out of range well.
items.quote: He's got very good movement. He'll dart in and out of range very well

items.claim: Jalin Turner is two and three in his last five fights.
items.quote: Jalin Turner, two and three in his last five fights

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes will chew up Jalin Turner's legs and slow down his movement to take him out.
items.quote: In this fight though, I think Kaue Fernandes is going to be able to chew up the legs, stay safe on the outside, get in, land his leg kicks and just slow down the movement of Jalin Turner and be able to take him out that way.

items.claim: Joel Alvarez is stepping in on short notice to face Chepe Mariscal.
items.quote: It's interesting that he is taking this on short notice cuz I often think of Joel as the guy that kind of needs a full camp

items.claim: Joel Alvarez has an insane submission arsenal and is very crafty on the ground.
items.quote: He's got an insane submission arsenal. Predominantly chokes is what he goes for... Very, very crafty on the ground.

items.claim: Chepe Mariscal has one of the best body kicks in the game.
items.quote: In fact, he's got one of the best body kicks in the game.
